title: Floor Lamp
description: You see a floor lamp with a warm orange lampshade stands near the window across from the couch.
details: The lamp probably dates back to the 70s. Its orange fabric shade fills the apartment with a soft amber glow. At night, with the blinds closed and the skyline glowing faintly beyond them, the room starts to feel less like an apartment and more like a private broadcast drifting through the dark.
takeFailure: The lamp already seems to be exactly where it belongs. You can't think of a better use for it.
